verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and model-runner CLI covering LLM, STT, TTS, VLM, tool calling, and hosted or local execution. It is not a product that authors or stores saved automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Tool calling and the voice agent are runtime inference features, not managed automation artifacts, and nothing in the evidence shows the product ships an automation-management capability.
